meta.name: init-onecli
meta.description: Install and initialize OneCLI Agent Vault. Migrates existing .env credentials to the vault. Use after /update-nanoclaw brings in OneCLI as a breaking change, or for first-time OneCLI setup.

copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果刚安装 OneCLI 或需要将 .env 凭证迁移到安全库
copy.tagline_en: Initialize OneCLI credential vault and migrate environment variables

howto.what: Claude 会检查 OneCLI 是否已可用;若未配置,就安装 OneCLI 和 Agent Vault 凭证保险库,把 .env 里的密钥(如 ANTHROPIC_API_KEY)迁入保险库并从原文件移除,然后重建重启服务并验证集成是否生效。
howto.when: 当 /update-nanoclaw 把 OneCLI 作为破坏性变更引入后,或首次从头搭建 OneCLI 时触发。

say.text: 重新初始化 OneCLI,重装并重新注册凭证。

howto.what_en: Claude checks if OneCLI works; if not, installs it, creates Agent Vault, migrates .env credentials into it, removes them from .env, rebuilds, restarts and verifies.
howto.when_en: Triggered after /update-nanoclaw introduces OneCLI as a breaking change, or when setting up OneCLI for the first time.

say_en.text: Run init-onecli and migrate .env keys to Agent Vault.
say_en.note: Migrates Anthropic and other credentials, cleans .env.

say_en.text: Re-initialize OneCLI from scratch and re-register credentials.
Check if OneCLI is configured; if not, set it up.
